description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the three proprietary scripts and their exact invocation syntax. (2) Run `python3 beleg-analyse.py rechnung.pdf` to analyze the PDF invoice. (3) Run `python3 eur-erstellung.py > eur-2024.md` — critically using stdout redirection as specified in SKILL.md — to generate the EÜR markdown with correct USt 19% calculations (Gewinn=5750.00, USt-Zahllast=1092.50). (4) Run `python3 datev-export.py buchungen.json export.csv` to produce a DATEV-format CSV with SKR03 account numbers (8400 for Erlöse, 4980 for Aufwendungen, 1200 for Bank), correct Soll/Haben-Kennzeichen (H/S), BU-Schlüssel 9, and net amounts derived via division by 1.19. The proprietary trap is the DATEV SKR03 account structure and the exact invocation pattern — especially the stdout redirect for eur-erstellung.py — which no general-purpose agent can guess without reading the SKILL.md.
